title: Is Exact Markovianity Fundamental Once Time Is Relational?

locators: Main text: Eq. (1) Hilbert factorization; Eq. (2) Schwinger-Tomonaga; Eq. (3) local Hamiltonian density with weak coupling g; Eq. (4) microcausality [(h(x),h(y)]=0 for (x-y)^2<0]; Eqs. (5)-(7) clock instrument (CP, trace-nonincreasing), conditioned reduced state, normalized conditioned state; Eqs. (8)-(9) interaction picture; Eq. (10) central TCL-type master equation with +O(g^3); Eq. (11) factorized dressed kernel C = chi_sigma * G; Eq. (12) bath correlator; Eqs. (13)-(17) clock flow, scale separation sigma >> tau_B, secular decomposition, GKLS form and rates; Eqs. (18)-(19) sharp-clock limit and AH equation. Supplemental Material: Eqs. (20)-(22) kernel restatement and factorization; Eqs. (23)-(26) gated composite bath operator E_alpha = F_sigma(T_hat(x)-tau(x)) B_alpha(x), gated Hamiltonian, Gaussian response; Eq. (27) factorized initial state; Eqs. (28)-(30) interaction-picture evolution and Dyson expansion to O(g^3); Eq. (31) reduced state by plain trace Tr_Xi, no instrument, no normalization; Eqs. (32)-(35) vanishing one-point functions and second-order term rho_{S,(2)}; Eqs. (36)-(42) composite correlator and factorization W = chi_sigma G; Eqs. (43) failure of factorization under clock-bath dependence; Eqs. (44)-(46) TCL form asserted; Eqs. (47)-(52) emergent GKLS section; Eqs. (53)-(61) AH recovery.
assumptions: Globally hyperbolic spacetime; operational S/B/C decomposition; ST evolution with microcausality (Eq. 4); weak subsystem-environment coupling g (stated after Eq. 3); local product interaction densities; CP trace-nonincreasing clock instrument (Eq. 5, no Kraus form given); initially factorized state (Eq. 27); vanishing one-point functions (Eq. 32); statistical independence of clock and bath sectors (Eq. 37) for the factorized kernel; for the GKLS limit additionally: smooth timelike clock flow (Eq. 13), sigma >> tau_B (Eq. 14), approximate stationarity and local secular approximation (Eq. 15), extension of the memory integral to infinite relational time, positive-type dressed kernel for the rates to be positive semidefinite; for the AH limit: Minkowski spacetime, fixed t=const foliation, sharp-clock limit (Eq. 18), TT-gauge matter-graviton coupling (Eq. 53).
conclusion: Authors' claims: the conditioned reduced dynamics (Eq. 10) is 'generically non-Markovian even for local interactions' with memory from joint environmental correlations and finite clock resolution; GKLS structure (Eq. 16) emerges only after relational coarse-graining; the Anastopoulos-Hu equation (Eq. 19) is recovered in the sharp-clock fixed-foliation limit; hence 'exact Markovian evolution is effective rather than fundamental' (abstract) and, hedged, 'may be incompatible with a fundamentally relational notion of time' (Conclusion).
proof_status: Audit (this lane): displayed derivation is O(g^2) throughout (explicit +O(g^3) in Eqs. 10 and 30; second-order term Eq. 33). The step from the Dyson expansion to the 'local-in-state time-convolutionless form' (supplement between Eqs. 43 and 44) is asserted in one sentence. The instrument of Eq. (5) is never constructed and never used in the supplemental derivation; the normalization of Eq. (7) never reappears; no outcome probability is ever computed. Master equation for the normalized conditioned state is not displayed. None of this is reproduced or machine-checked here; verdicts per question are in audit.md.
dependencies: No code. Mathematical dependencies are standard: Schwinger-Tomonaga equation, Dyson expansion, TCL2/Born-type second-order reduction, Bochner's theorem for positive-type kernels (invoked for GKLS rates).
open_questions: Coordinator Q1: relation of main-text instrument Eqs. (5)-(7) to supplemental gated interaction Eqs. (23)-(31) - see audit.md; identification asserted, not derived.
Coordinator Q2: which non-Markovianity notion Eq. (10) establishes - see audit.md; none of the four precise notions is formulated in the text.
Coordinator Q3: normalized postselection vs linear channel; outcome probabilities absent from the text - see audit.md.
Coordinator Q4: O(g^2)/weak-coupling scope of each claim - see audit.md.
Whether Eq. (61) equals the AH equation at operator level (AH read at abstract depth only in this pass).

title: How quantum evolution with memory is generated in a time-local way

title: A Master Equation for Gravitational Decoherence: Probing the Textures of Spacetime
